nodes.title: SG-6.1.2 · BootScene emits a typed characterClick event to React
nodes.body:
Context: BootScene.createCharacter (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) plays the interact animation on pointerdown but tells React nothing. The typed bus in game/frontend/src/phaser/events.ts has only objectHover, objectClick and sceneReady. Desired behavior: add a characterClick event type and emit it on NPC click without changing the animation. Expected result: React subscribers receive { id } for the clicked character. Why: dialogue and interaction for NPCs (SG-6.1) needs a typed signal from Phaser.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the PhaserToReactEvents interface, When characterClick is emitted with { id: 'boy' }, Then a subscribed handler receives exactly that payload once.
- Given a BootScene with a character sprite, When pointerdown fires on it, Then phaserToReact emits characterClick with the character spec id.
- Given a character with an interact animation, When it is clicked, Then the interact animation still plays and returns to idle.


## Scope
- In scope: characterClick type in events.ts
- In scope: emit in BootScene.createCharacter
- In scope: unit tests with Phaser mocked
- Out of scope: React-side handling of characterClick
- Out of scope: dialogue content for NPCs
- Out of scope: new assets
- Preserve: objectClick, objectHover and sceneReady events
- Preserve: existing interact-then-idle animation behavior
- Preserve: Phaser 3.90 APIs


## Technical constraints
- Phaser is mocked in unit tests; no browser or live server
- Use the existing phaserToReact bus; no new event system


## Definition of done
- characterClick is typed and emitted on NPC click
- Unit tests for event type and BootScene emit pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · PhaserToReactEvents declares a typed characterClick event
nodes.body:
Context: events.ts defines PhaserToReactEvents with objectHover, objectClick and sceneReady. Desired behavior: add characterClick: { id: string } so emit and on are type-checked for it. Expected result: handlers subscribed to characterClick receive the payload. Why: React needs a typed NPC click signal distinct from object clicks.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given phaserToReact, When emit('characterClick', { id: 'boy' }) is called, Then a handler registered via on('characterClick') is called once with { id: 'boy' }.
- Given the events file, When type-checked, Then characterClick payload is { id: string } and existing events are unchanged.


## Scope
- In scope: PhaserToReactEvents interface in events.ts
- Out of scope: BootScene emission
- Out of scope: React subscribers
- Preserve: existing events and createEventBus behavior


## Technical constraints
- Keep events.ts dependency-free


## Definition of done
- characterClick present in PhaserToReactEvents


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · BootScene emits characterClick when an NPC is clicked and still plays interact
nodes.body:
Context: createCharacter's pointerdown handler returns early when idleKey is missing or interactKey equals idleKey, so any emit placed after those guards would be skipped for characters without a distinct interact animation. Desired behavior: emit characterClick { id: spec.id } first on every click, then run the existing animation logic. Expected result: React always learns of the click. Why: NPCs without interact animations must still be clickable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a character sprite, When its pointerdown listener runs, Then phaserToReact emits characterClick with { id: spec.id }.
- Given a character whose interact animation exists, When clicked, Then sprite.play is called with the interact key after the emit.
- Given a character with no distinct interact animation, When clicked, Then characterClick is still emitted and no animation change occurs.


## Scope
- In scope: createCharacter pointerdown handler in BootScene.ts
- Out of scope: events.ts type
- Out of scope: React handling
- Preserve: idle animation start
- Preserve: interact then idle via ANIMATION_COMPLETE
- Preserve: objectClick forwarding


## Technical constraints
- Use phaserToReact already imported in BootScene.ts
- Phaser 3.90 APIs only


## Dependencies
- REQ1


## Definition of done
- Emit occurs before animation guards


## Clarifying questions
- None
